scope: Pausader, Perez-Garcia and the joint Rhodes-Vargas report: the third mathematical-physics batch.

independent_build.method: Archive the exact source commit and pinned theme commit into a clean directory; run all 43 workflow source checks, build, then run four generated-site checks.

live_verification.tls: Default certificate verification; no insecure overrides
live_verification.comparison: Compare entire responses with the independent build, normalizing only between-tag indentation and whitespace between HTML tags and display-math boundaries or adjacent display-math blocks. Prose and formula contents are preserved.
live_verification.browser_review: Public subject navigation and the 4J00 overview inspected in the in-app browser; rendered formulas, Chinese labels and links visible.

historical_records: The third-validation record preserves the earlier local acceptance status. This separate record establishes the later public deployment.
